mapper.select: SELECT MIN(C.ACCID) FROM ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_BSEG${bookYear} B LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_BKPF F ON F.GLH = B.GLH AND F.AYEAR = B.AYEAR LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACCOUNT C ON B.ACCID= C.ACCID AND B.AYEAR = C.AYEAR LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_SUM S ON B.ACCID = S.ACCID AND B.AYEAR = S.AYEAR AND B.AMONTH = S.AMONTH WHERE B.AMONTH >= #{minMonth} AND B.AMONTH <= #{maxMonth}

SELECT NVL(SUM(B.MD),0) AS MD,NVL(SUM(B.MC),0) AS MC FROM ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_BSEG${bookYear} B LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_BKPF F ON F.GLH = B.GLH AND F.AYEAR = B.AYEAR WHERE B.AMONTH = #{month} AND B.ACCID = #{accid} AND (F.PZ_DATE < TO_DATE(#{pzDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') OR (F.PZ_DATE = TO_DATE(#{pzDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND B.PZH < #{pzh}) OR (F.PZ_DATE = TO_DATE(#{pzDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND B.PZH = #{pzh} AND B.ENTRYID < #{entryId}))

SELECT T2.* FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM RN,T1.* FROM ( SELECT C.ACCID as accid, B.LINETEXT as lineText, NVL (B.MD, '0') AS md, NVL (B.MC, '0') AS mc, C.ACCNAME1 as accName, C.DC as dc, F.PZH as pzh, TO_CHAR(F.PZ_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as pzDate, NVL (S.QCMD, '0') AS qcmd, NVL (S.QCMC, '0') AS qcmc, NVL (S.QMDC, '0') AS qmdc, NVL (S.BQMD, '0') AS bqmd, NVL (S.BQMC, '0') AS bqmc, NVL (S.LJMD, '0') AS ljmd, NVL (S.LJMC, '0') AS ljmc, NVL (S.QMMC, '0') AS qmmc, NVL (S.QMMD, '0') AS qmmd, NVL (S.QCDC, '0') AS qcdc, TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR(F.PZ_DATE, 'dd')) AS dayNo,TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR(F.PZ_DATE, 'MM')) AS amonth FROM ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_BSEG${bookYear} B LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_BKPF F ON F.GLH = B.GLH AND F.AYEAR = B.AYEAR LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACCOUNT C ON B.ACCID = C.ACCID AND B.AYEAR = C.AYEAR LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_SUM S ON S.AYEAR = B.AYEAR AND S.ACCID = B.ACCID AND S.AMONTH = B.AMONTH WHERE F.AYEAR = '${bookYear}' AND B.ACCID = #{accid} ORDER BY F.PZ_DATE ASC,F.PZH ASC,B.ENTRYID ASC ) T1 ) T2 WHERE RN = #{pageSize}

SELECT NVL(SUM(B.MD),0) AS MD,NVL(SUM(B.MC),0) AS MC FROM ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_BSEG${bookYear} B LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_BKPF F ON F.GLH = B.GLH AND F.AYEAR = B.AYEAR WHERE B.AMONTH = #{month} AND B.ACCID = #{accid} AND (F.PZ_DATE < #{pzDate} OR (F.PZ_DATE = #{pzDate} AND B.PZH < #{pzh}) OR (F.PZ_DATE = #{pzDate} AND B.PZH = #{pzh} AND B.ENTRYID <= #{entryId}))

SELECT C.ACCID as accid, B.LINETEXT as lineText,B.GLH AS GLH, NVL (B.MD, '0') AS md, NVL (B.MC, '0') AS mc, C.ACCNAME1 as accName, C.DC as dc, F.PZH as pzh, TO_CHAR(F.PZ_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as pzDate,B.ENTRYID AS entryId, NVL (S.QCMD, '0') AS qcmd, NVL (S.QCMC, '0') AS qcmc, NVL (S.QMDC, '0') AS qmdc, NVL (S.BQMD, '0') AS bqmd, NVL (S.BQMC, '0') AS bqmc, NVL (S.LJMD, '0') AS ljmd, NVL (S.LJMC, '0') AS ljmc, NVL (S.QMMC, '0') AS qmmc, NVL (S.QMMD, '0') AS qmmd, NVL (S.QCDC, '0') AS qcdc, TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR(F.PZ_DATE, 'dd')) AS dayNo,TO_NUMBER (TO_CHAR(F.PZ_DATE, 'MM')) AS amonth FROM ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_BSEG${year} B LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_BKPF F ON F.GLH = B.GLH AND F.AYEAR = B.AYEAR LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACCOUNT C ON B.ACCID = C.ACCID AND B.AYEAR = C.AYEAR LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_SUM S ON S.AYEAR = B.AYEAR AND S.ACCID = B.ACCID AND S.AMONTH = B.AMONTH WHERE F.AYEAR = '${year}' AND B.ACCID = #{accid} AND ${sqlStr} ORDER BY F.PZ_DATE ASC,F.PZH ASC,B.ENTRYID ASC

SELECT C.ACCID as accid, B.LINETEXT as lineText, NVL(B.MD, '0') as md, NVL(B.MC, '0') as mc,C.ACCNAME1 as accName, C.DC as dc, F.PZH as pzh, TO_CHAR(F.PZ_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as pzDate, NVL (S.QCMD, '0') as qcmd, NVL (S.QCMC, '0') as qcmc, S.QMDC as qmdc, S.BQMD as bqmd, S.BQMC as bqmc, S.LJMD as ljmd, S.LJMC as ljmc, S.QMMC as qmmc, S.QMMD as qmmd, S.QCDC as qcdc,B.ENTRYID as entryId,B.AMONTH AS AMONTH,B.GLH AS GLH FROM ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_BSEG${year} B LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_BKPF F ON F.GLH = B.GLH AND F.AYEAR = B.AYEAR LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACCOUNT C ON B.ACCID = C.ACCID AND B.AYEAR = C.AYEAR LEFT JOIN ${dbSource}.TBL_ACC_SUM S ON B.ACCID = S.ACCID AND B.AYEAR = S.AYEAR AND B.AMONTH = S.AMONTH WHERE B.ACCID = #{accid} AND ${sqlStr} ORDER BY F.PZ_DATE ASC,F.PZH ASC,B.ENTRYID ASC
